info.title: FossaPay API
info.description: FossaPay API for checkout wallets, customer management, NGN wallets, crypto wallets, transfers, fees, banks, and webhooks.

post.summary: Create an NGN wallet for a customer

get.summary: Get NGN wallet by account number

post.summary: Transfer NGN for free between customer wallets
post.description: Free internal transfer between two FossaPay customers under the same business. Both accounts must be FossaPay NGN wallets.

post.summary: Transfer NGN to an external bank
post.description: Send NGN to an account at another supported Nigerian bank. Use wallet-to-wallet transfer instead when both customers belong to the same FossaPay business.
